site.title: Enclose
site.headline: Enclose is an open-source workbench for CAD made with agents.
site.description: It works with your Claude, Codex or Grok subscription, or opencode with the models you bring. Fork it and make it yours.
site.summary: Enclose is an open-source app for Mac and Linux for CAD made with agents. Click a part, say what should change, and Claude, Codex, Grok or opencode edits the code and rebuilds the model.
